name: OmniRDP
description: Continue RDPEGFX implementation from RDPEGFX_Implementation_Plan.md while obeying VIEWER_SERVER_REFACTOR_PLAN.md module boundaries. viewer_server.c must remain a high-level coordinator; canonical pixels belong in viewer_framebuffer, publishing/coalescing in viewer_publisher, RDPEGFX session/protocol sequencing in viewer_gfx_pipeline, and uncompressed payload construction in viewer_gfx_codec_uncompressed. GFX remains disabled by default until explicitly gated in a later story.

userStories.title: Finalize RDPEGFX lifecycle and caps seam
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the existing RDPEGFX lifecycle and capability negotiation extraction verified and kept behind narrow pipeline APIs so that viewer_server.c remains a high-level coordinator without hidden singleton orchestration callbacks.
acceptanceCriteria: viewer_gfx_pipeline owns RdpgfxServerContext create/free/init/uninit/open and CapsAdvertise/CapsConfirm mechanics.
viewer_server.c does not construct CapsConfirm PDUs or choose caps directly, and explicitly performs server-owned fallback/join orchestration from pipeline result flags.
Frame acknowledgement remains in viewer_server.c for this story.
Viewer and backend GFX remain disabled by default.

userStories.notes: Re-verification/finalization completed: Debug build and ctest passed, and oracle review accepted the lifecycle/caps seam. Do not broaden into reset/create/map/full-frame activation, frame ACK migration, framebuffer routing, publisher policy, or codec behavior. Orchestrator coordinates stories/progress; the bounded fixer/Ralph implementation agent may edit code/tests/CMake for future stories.

userStories.notes: Completed: added a gated/default-off classic latest-state policy owned by viewer_publisher and wired to explicit viewer.classic_latest_state_* config keys. viewer_server.c only asks publisher for queue decisions and per-viewer latest framebuffer snapshots, preserves default FIFO/drop-oldest/full-refresh behavior when the policy is disabled, and replaces stale queued classic backlog with one framebuffer-backed baseline only when the policy is explicitly enabled and configured limits are exceeded. userStories.notes: Completed: viewer_gfx_codec_uncompressed builds RDPGFX_CODECID_UNCOMPRESSED surface commands from canonical PIXEL_FORMAT_BGRX32 ViewerFramebufferSnapshot inputs.
